days.summary: Peter declared that God raised up Jesus and sent Him to bless people by turning them from their sins. God's guidance away from sin is a blessing, not a restriction. Thank God for the ways He has turned you from harmful paths, and follow His leading today.

days.title: Wholehearted praise
days.summary: Peter describes governing authorities as sent to punish evil and to praise those who do good. God designed the world so that goodness is worth honoring, and He is the source of all good. Notice and honor goodness in others today, and give praise to God.

days.title: Generosity that honors God
days.summary: The religious leaders told the healed blind man to give God the praise while denying the role of Jesus, but he simply testified to what had happened. True praise means telling the truth about what God has done. Share your honest testimony today, even if it is unpopular.

days.title: Wholehearted praise
days.summary: Psalm 106 ends by blessing God from everlasting to everlasting and inviting all the people to say Amen. Looking honestly at our story reveals God's patient faithfulness, which leads to worship. Reflect on His faithfulness today and join the chorus of praise.

days.title: Made right and called to righteousness
days.summary: Paul teaches that the fruit of the Spirit is shown in goodness, righteousness, and truth. These qualities grow naturally in those made right with God and walking in His light. Ask the Spirit to grow His fruit in you today.

days.title: Wholehearted praise
days.summary: Paul notes that Christ came from Israel as a human being, yet He is God over all, blessed forever. Jesus is both fully human and fully God, worthy of eternal praise. Marvel at who Jesus is today and worship Him wholeheartedly.

days.title: The peace God gives
days.summary: Jesus blesses peacemakers and says they will be called children of God. Peacemakers actively work for reconciliation, reflecting the heart of God, the great Peacemaker. Look for one opportunity to make peace today.

days.title: Wholehearted praise
days.summary: As Jesus entered Jerusalem, the crowd shouted praise and Hosanna, celebrating the coming kingdom of David. Jesus is the promised King worthy of wholehearted praise. Lift your voice in praise to Him today and celebrate His coming kingdom.

days.title: Wholehearted praise
days.summary: Proverbs encourages husbands to rejoice in the wife of their youth and treat their marriage as a blessed fountain. Contentment grows when we rejoice in the gifts God has already given. Celebrate the people God has placed in your life today.

days.title: Remembering God's goodness
days.summary: Paul ended a debate by saying that the churches of God have no custom of being contentious. Remembering God's goodness helps us let go of a quarrelsome spirit and choose grace. Pause before arguments today and choose unity over the need to be right.

days.title: Wholehearted praise
days.summary: John hears heaven called to rejoice because God has judged corrupt Babylon and vindicated His people. This joy celebrates God's justice, not suffering. Take heart that God sees every injustice and will one day make all things right.

days.title: Generosity that honors God
days.summary: John remembers the feeding of the five thousand as the place where the Lord gave thanks before multiplying the bread. Jesus gave thanks for a small offering, and God made it more than enough. Thank God for what you have today, even if it seems small, and offer it to Him.

days.title: Generosity that honors God
days.summary: The psalmist asked God to save and gather His people so that they could give thanks to His holy name. Thanksgiving is the goal of God's saving work in our lives. Remember an answered prayer today and offer God your gratitude.

days.title: A life of thanksgiving
days.summary: Paul urges believers to replace crude and careless talk with the giving of thanks. Gratitude in our conversations lifts others up and points them to God's goodness. Pay attention to your words today and fill them with thanksgiving.

days.title: Living by faith
days.summary: Isaiah praised the LORD as his own God, who has done wonderful things and whose ancient plans are faithful and true. Remembering God's works strengthens our faith in His plans for the future. Praise Him today and trust His faithful plans.

days.title: Resting in God's presence
days.summary: Paul quotes Isaiah's promise that the barren woman will rejoice because she will have many children through God's grace. God can bring abundance from places of emptiness and turn sorrow into joy. Bring your empty places to Him today and rest in His presence.

days.title: Wholehearted praise
days.summary: Jesus taught that the servant found faithfully doing his work when his master returns will be blessed. Readiness for Christ's return means being faithful in the ordinary tasks He has entrusted to us. Be found faithfully doing your work today.

days.title: Wholehearted praise
days.summary: At midnight, beaten and in chains, Paul and Silas prayed and sang praises to God, and the other prisoners heard them. Praise in hard places reflects deep trust in God and becomes a testimony to others. Praise God today, even in your midnight season.

days.title: Wholehearted praise
days.summary: At His final meal with His disciples, Jesus blessed the bread before breaking it and giving it to His disciples as His body. Even facing suffering, He gave thanks. Remember His sacrifice with gratitude today and let it shape your life.

days.title: Wholehearted praise
days.summary: Melchisedec, king and priest of the most high God, met Abraham after his victory and blessed him. When God gives us success, the right response is praise and gratitude, not boasting. Bless God for a recent victory and give Him the credit today.

days.title: Wholehearted praise
days.summary: In Luke, Jesus blesses the faithful steward who cares for the household entrusted to him until the master returns. Those with responsibility for others are called to serve them faithfully, and the Lord Himself honors such service. Care faithfully for the people entrusted to you today.

days.title: Made right and called to righteousness
days.summary: Paul uses David to show that God credits righteousness to people apart from their works. This blessedness of grace, rediscovered at the Reformation, frees us from earning God's approval. Give thanks today for the gift of being made right with God by grace.

days.title: Living by faith
days.summary: David asked God to hear his prayer, appealing not to his own goodness but to God's faithfulness and righteousness. Our confidence in prayer rests on God's character, not our record. Bring your requests to Him today, trusting His faithfulness.

days.title: Prayer that turns toward God
days.summary: An angel told Cornelius, a Roman centurion, that God had heard his prayers and remembered his generosity. God sees and hears those who seek Him, and no faithful prayer is forgotten. Keep praying and giving, trusting that He hears.

days.title: Prayer that turns toward God
days.summary: When Hezekiah wept and prayed in his illness, God said He had heard his prayer and seen his tears, and He added fifteen years to his life. Our prayers truly matter to God, who notices every tear. Pour out your heart to Him today.

days.title: God's saving work
days.summary: Paul expressed that his heart's desire and prayer was for his own people to be saved. Love keeps praying for those who resist God, trusting His saving work. Pray today by name for those you long to see come to faith.

days.title: Prayer that turns toward God
days.summary: Jesus cleared the temple, declaring that God's house should be a house of prayer, not a den of thieves. Our hearts can become crowded with distractions that squeeze out prayer. Ask Jesus to clear away what crowds your heart and make room for prayer.

days.title: The peace God gives
days.summary: David asked God to hear his cry and not be silent at his tears, describing himself as a stranger and sojourner on earth. Recognizing that we are travelers with God brings peace in our troubles. Bring your tears to God today and find peace in His presence.

days.title: Strength supplied by God
days.summary: Hebrews describes Jesus praying with loud cries and tears to the Father, and being heard because of His reverent submission. Praying through tears is not weak faith; it is praying like Jesus. Pour out your heart honestly today and find strength in surrender.

days.title: The God who hears
days.summary: Jesus said the first commandment begins with the call to hear, for the Lord our God is one Lord. Prayer begins not only with speaking but with listening to God. Take time today to listen to Him before you speak.

days.title: Prayer that turns toward God
days.summary: Isaiah urges us to seek the LORD while He may be found and call on Him while He is near. God is eager to be found and to abundantly pardon those who return to Him. Do not wait; seek Him today.

days.title: Receiving and extending mercy
days.summary: David asked God to hear him and have mercy, remembering how God had given him room in times of distress. Remembering past mercies gives us confidence to ask for more. Receive God's mercy today and extend it to someone under pressure.

days.title: Living by faith
days.summary: When an Ethiopian official asked to be baptized, Philip said that wholehearted belief was all that was needed, and the man confessed that Jesus Christ is the Son of God. Faith in Jesus opens the door to God for anyone. Affirm your faith in Him today.

days.title: Prayer that turns toward God
days.summary: John saw the prayers of the saints rising before God like incense from an angel's hand. Our prayers are gathered and received in God's presence and lead to His action on earth. Pray faithfully today, knowing that heaven is listening.

days.title: Prayer that turns toward God
days.summary: Jesus told Nathanael that He had seen him under the fig tree before Philip called him. God sees and knows us long before we turn to Him in prayer. Turn toward Him today, knowing that He already sees you and loves you.

days.title: The God who hears
days.summary: Jesus perceived the unspoken thoughts of the religious leaders and answered them. God hears not only our words but the silent thoughts and longings of our hearts. Bring your unspoken thoughts to Him openly today.

days.title: Living in God's presence
days.summary: John teaches that whoever confesses Jesus as the Son of God has God dwelling in them, and they in God. God's presence is a reality established by faith, not a feeling we must create. Remember throughout the day that God dwells in you.

days.title: Prayer that turns toward God
days.summary: God promises a day when He will answer before His people call and hear them while they are still speaking. He is eager, not reluctant, to respond to His children. Pray with confidence today and thank Him for the times He answered before you asked.

days.title: The God who hears
days.summary: The crowd struggled to understand how the eternal Christ could be lifted up to die, and asked who the Son of man was. God hears our honest questions and invites us to keep walking in the light we have. Bring your questions to Him today and trust the One who was lifted up.

days.title: The God who hears
days.summary: When John the Baptist doubted in prison, Jesus answered with compassion and pointed to the evidence of His works. God hears our doubts and responds with patience. Bring your doubts honestly to Jesus and look at what He has done.

days.title: Generosity that honors God
days.summary: Paul teaches married couples to give themselves generously to each other, setting aside time apart only by mutual consent for prayer. Love gives freely and makes room to seek God together. Look for ways to give generously in your closest relationships and to pray together.

days.title: Christ our promised Savior
days.summary: Paul declared that if he were trying to please people, he could not be a servant of Christ. Belonging to Christ frees us from the exhausting need for human approval. Let go of people-pleasing today and live for the One whose love you already have.

days.title: The God who hears
days.summary: Proverbs teaches that while we prepare our hearts, the right answer of the tongue comes from the LORD. We can trust God to give us the right words in difficult moments. Pray before important conversations today and trust Him to guide your words.

days.title: Serving with a willing heart
days.summary: Anna, an elderly widow, served God with fasting and prayer night and day for decades and was among the first to recognize Jesus. Faithful prayer is a powerful form of service, even when unseen. Thank God for those who pray for you, and serve Him through prayer today.

days.title: Living in God's presence
days.summary: John hears that God will dwell with His people, and God Himself will be with them as their God. This is the goal of the whole biblical story, and we taste it even now through Jesus and the Spirit. Let the hope of God's presence fill your heart today.

days.title: The God who hears
days.summary: Paul's friends wept and begged him not to go to Jerusalem, but he was ready to suffer for Jesus, and they finally said the Lord's will be done. Love prays honestly and ultimately trusts loved ones into God's hands. Pray for someone facing a hard path and trust them to God.

days.title: The God who hears
days.summary: John shares what he has seen and heard of Jesus so that others may join in fellowship with believers and with the Father and the Son. Human gatherings around the table are glimpses of this deeper fellowship with God. Give thanks today for the people in your life and for friendship with God.

days.title: Guidance for the path ahead
days.summary: Paul told the Romans that God was his witness that he prayed for them without ceasing, and that his prayers shaped his plans to visit them. Praying for others often guides us in how to love and serve them. Pray specifically for someone today and ask God how you can serve them.

days.title: Generosity that honors God
days.summary: Paul refused to commend himself, pointing to those who glory in outward appearance rather than in the heart. God looks at the heart, and generosity that honors Him flows from sincere love. Give something today quietly, without seeking recognition.

days.title: Prayer that turns toward God
days.summary: God told His people He would not hear their prayers because their hands were full of injustice, but He then invited them to be washed and made clean. True prayer turns toward God and away from sin. Before you pray today, ask God to search your heart and make you clean.

days.title: Prayer that turns toward God
days.summary: When Jesus cried out to God from the cross, bystanders misunderstood and thought He was calling for Elijah. Even in His darkest moment, Jesus turned to God in honest prayer, and the Father heard. Cry out to God honestly today, knowing He understands even when others do not.

days.title: Prayer that turns toward God
days.summary: Pilate heard the crowd and let fear of their opinion overrule his conscience, while Jesus silently entrusted Himself to the Father. Prayer is a turning of the heart toward God rather than the crowd. Choose today to listen to God above every other voice.

days.title: The first promise of victory
days.summary: Immediately after the fall, God promised that a descendant of the woman would crush the serpent's head. This was the first promise of the Savior who would defeat evil through His own suffering. Rest today in the God who answered our failure with a promise.

days.title: Blessing promised to all nations
days.summary: God promised Abraham that through his descendant all the nations of the earth would be blessed. This promise was fulfilled in Jesus, whose coming is good news for every people. Celebrate that you are included in this blessing and share it with others.

days.title: The Star who will come
days.summary: The prophet Balaam, hired to curse Israel, instead foresaw a Star out of Jacob and a Sceptre out of Israel. Centuries later, wise men followed a star to the newborn King. God's promises may be seen from far off, but they always come to pass.

days.title: The promised Prophet
days.summary: Moses promised that God would raise up a Prophet like him, and the people were to listen to Him. Jesus is that promised Prophet, the very Word of God. Take time today to listen to His words.

days.title: The everlasting throne
days.summary: God promised David that He would establish the kingdom of his descendant forever. Centuries later, the angel told Mary that her Son would receive David's throne and reign forever. God's promises may take time, but He always fulfills them.

days.title: God's anointed Son
days.summary: Psalm 2 declares God's decree that His anointed King is His own Son, despite the raging of the nations. Jesus is that Son, appointed by the Father to reign. Rest in His unshakable kingdom today.

days.title: The eternal King
days.summary: Psalm 45 addresses the King as God, whose throne is forever and whose sceptre is righteous. Hebrews applies this to Jesus, the eternal King who always rules rightly. Bring your loyalty and trust to Him today.

days.title: All nations worship the King
days.summary: Psalm 72 envisions all kings bowing before the King and all nations serving Him. This points to Jesus, whose reign brings justice and compassion for the needy. Worship Him today and let His compassion shape how you treat those in need.

days.title: The Branch from Jesse
days.summary: Isaiah promised that a shoot would come from the stump of Jesse and a Branch would grow from his roots. Jesus is that Branch, new life from what looked dead. Bring your cut-down places to God today and trust Him to bring new growth.

days.title: Rejoicing in God's salvation
days.summary: Isaiah foresees a day when God's people will say, this is our God, we have waited for Him, and we will rejoice in His salvation. Waiting is part of the life of faith, and it is never in vain. Let your waiting be hopeful and rejoice in the salvation God brings.

days.title: God's chosen Servant
days.summary: God introduces His chosen Servant, upheld and delighted in by Him, filled with His Spirit to bring justice to the nations. Jesus is that gentle Servant who will not break the bruised or quench the faint. Receive His gentle care today.

days.title: A light to the nations
days.summary: God declared that His Servant would be not only for Israel but a light to the nations, bringing salvation to the ends of the earth. Jesus is that light for every people. Let His light shine on you today and carry it to others.

days.title: Good news of salvation
days.summary: Isaiah describes the beautiful feet of the messenger who brings good news of peace, salvation, and God's reign. When Jesus was born, angels brought this news, and now we are called to share it too. Look for an opportunity to bring good news to someone today.

days.title: Peace through the suffering Servant
days.summary: Isaiah describes the Servant who was wounded for our transgressions and whose suffering brings us peace and healing. The child born in Bethlehem came to die for us. Remember today that the peace He gives was purchased by His suffering.

days.title: Arise, for the Light has come
days.summary: Isaiah calls God's people to arise and shine because their light has come and the glory of the LORD has risen upon them. When Jesus was born, the Light of the world came, and we are called to reflect His glory. Arise from weariness today and shine His light to others.

days.title: The righteous Branch
days.summary: Jeremiah promised a righteous Branch from David's line who would reign with justice and righteousness. Jesus is that King, who rules perfectly and gives His righteousness to those who trust Him. Place your hope in Him today.

days.title: The humble King comes
days.summary: Zechariah called Jerusalem to rejoice because their King was coming, just and saving, yet humble and riding on a donkey. Jesus came in humility, from the manger to Jerusalem, so that anyone could approach Him. Rejoice in your humble King and come near to Him today.

days.title: The Lord comes to His temple
days.summary: Malachi promised a messenger to prepare the way and the Lord suddenly coming to His temple, fulfilled in John the Baptist and Jesus. After centuries of silence, God kept His word. Keep seeking Him today, even if He seems silent.

days.title: The Ruler from Bethlehem
days.summary: The scholars pointed to the prophecy that the ruler of God's people would come from small Bethlehem. God often chooses small places and ordinary people to accomplish great purposes. Take heart today that God can do great things through small beginnings.

days.title: The beloved Son
days.summary: At the baptism of Jesus, the Father declared from heaven that this is His beloved Son in whom He is well pleased. Through faith in Jesus, we are brought into the Father's love as His beloved children. Rest in His love today, knowing it reaches you through Christ.

days.title: The Father delights in the Son
days.summary: At the baptism of Jesus, the Father spoke directly to Him, saying, Thou art My beloved Son. This reveals the personal, delighted love between the Father and the Son. Let that warmth fill your heart, knowing God speaks love over His children through Jesus.

days.title: Good news for the broken
days.summary: Jesus declared His mission from Isaiah: to bring good news to the poor, heal the brokenhearted, and free the captive and bruised. His coming is good news especially for those who are hurting. If you are hurting, know Jesus came for you, and if you are well, reach out to someone who is.

days.title: The Lamb of God
days.summary: John the Baptist pointed to Jesus as the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world. All the old sacrifices pointed forward to Him. Behold the Lamb today and let Him lift the weight of your guilt.

days.title: The Bread of Life
days.summary: Jesus declared that He is the bread of life, and those who come to Him will never hunger or thirst. Born in Bethlehem, the house of bread, and laid in a manger, He came to nourish our souls. Come to Jesus today and let Him satisfy your heart.

days.title: The Light of the world
days.summary: Jesus declared that He is the light of the world and that His followers will have the light of life. He came to shine into every darkness of our world and our hearts. Follow Him today and share His light with others.

days.title: The Good Shepherd
days.summary: Shepherds first heard of the birth of Jesus, who later declared Himself the Good Shepherd who gives His life for the sheep. He knows, guides, and protects His people, and His care never ends. Rest today in the care of your Good Shepherd.

days.title: The Resurrection and the Life
days.summary: Jesus told grieving Martha that He is the resurrection and the life, and those who believe in Him will live even though they die. The child born in Bethlehem came to conquer death. Bring your grief to Him today and hold on to His hope.

days.title: The Way, Truth, and Life
days.summary: Jesus declared that He is the way, the truth, and the life, and that no one comes to the Father except through Him. Everything we need to come to God is found in Jesus. As the year ends, make Him your way, truth, and life.

days.title: Believe and have life
days.summary: John wrote his Gospel so that readers would believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and have life through His name. Scripture is an invitation to faith and life. Reflect on how God has spoken to you through His Word this year and respond in faith.

days.title: Salvation in Jesus alone
days.summary: Peter boldly declared that salvation is found in no one else but Jesus, for there is no other name by which we must be saved. This is good news: God has provided one sure way, open to everyone. Call on the name of Jesus with gratitude and share Him with love.

days.title: Come, Lord Jesus
days.summary: The Bible ends with the promise of Jesus to come quickly and the prayer, Come, Lord Jesus. This hope has carried God's people through every year of history. As the year ends, make this prayer your own and step into the new year with hope.
